name: OryphemCoin
description: OryphemCoin (OPC) is the on-chain learning-state and reward token of the QLoot e-learning platform. It is an ERC-1155 multi-token: token id 0 is the OPC balance (integer point unit, decimals = 0); token ids >= 1000000 are badge proof tokens (one unit per awarded badge).

features: Per-user OPC balance with XP and level (100 XP per level)
Courses: create, enroll, complete (pays OPC + XP + badge)
Badges: registered metadata, soulbound or transferable, per-user proof tokens
Achievements: arbitrary unlockable achievements per user
Idempotent rewards keyed by uint256 idempotency keys
Treasury accounting with deposits and withdrawals
utility: Reward for classrooms, quests, exams and courses
properties.custodial_note: The treasury custodies OPC on-chain; per-user balances are also mirrored on-chain and reconciled against the QLoot double-entry ledger. Soulbound badges cannot be transferred.
